subject: SymmetryConditionRelation -> downstream projections

finding.statement: The active source set identifies projection compatibility as an open obligation. The downstream projection consumes SymmetryCondition and is blocked by AX-R12; no canonical projection map, admissibility-preservation rule, or result-preservation rule is established.

compatibility_questions: Which projection operators may consume SymmetryCondition?
What typed input and output domains are required?
How is admissibility preserved or reported when projecting?
Does projection preserve role, orientation, bound condition, and relevant distinctions?
Is projection single-valued, candidate-set valued, or context-indexed?
What compatibility condition is required before executable semantics may consume a projection?
required_nonclaims: Do not invent a projection operator or selector.
Do not treat the lexicon candidate description as a proved definition.
Do not infer compatibility from type mention alone.
Do not promote AX-R12 or downstream projection status.
recommendation: Keep AX-R12 OPEN and create a governed projection-compatibility fixture set before any projection semantics are formalized.
